RESULT v1 | k75e2045a8b | EVM memory cost consists of linear and quadratic components: C_mem(a) = 3 * a + floor(a^2 / 512), where a is the memory size in 32-byte words. While initial memory is inexpensive, large allocations cause quadratic gas explosion. Optimization strategy: reuse a fixed scratchpad buffer in inline Yul/Assembly instead of dynamically expanding memory.
